name: ec-sigma
description: Sigma's dreamDEX Event Contract strategy: reads SigmaOracle's fair value (stubbed until the reactivity feed is proven live), quantizes it onto the venue's tick grid, and logs the trade it would place. DRY_RUN only in this build.
notes: No separate npm install was run for these deps — Node's module resolution walks up to the repo root's node_modules, which already has both packages installed at the exact versions listed here. Confirmed working via a smoke import before writing any real code.
This package.json exists so `bot/` has its own manifest (per the task's isolation requirement) without touching or re-locking the repo root's package-lock.json while another process may be using it.
